Subject: Repo webhook integration + demo request

Hi Olga,

I signed up for Redwood yesterday and poked around the self-serve flow (great UX so far). Our team at CodeLoom Labs is evaluating ways to wire up repo-level webhooks to trigger inference pipelines for code search and triage. A few quick technical questions before a demo:

- Do you surface a GitHub App or an OAuth app for repo-level events?
- Can Redwood handle multiple orgs under one account (we have a parent org + several team orgs)?
- Any documented rate limits on webhook delivery or inbound token exchange?

We'd like a short 30-min demo and a technical pre-call would be helpful. We are PST-based (San Francisco) and can do 9–11am PST or 2–4pm PST Wed/Thu this week.

Thanks —
Alex Kim
Platform Engineer, CodeLoom Labs

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for signing up. Happy to run a focused 30-minute session on webhooks and org setup. Quick answers up front, and then a couple of pre-call asks so we can make the demo productive:

Short answers:
- We support both a GitHub App and OAuth flow. For repo-scoped event delivery the GitHub App gives the cleanest experience (install per org or per repo).
- Multiple orgs are supported; you can map orgs to a single Redwood account and we surface per-org routing and permissions.
- Webhook delivery and API rate limits depend on your plan and whether you use our hosted routing or your VPC. Default hosted accounts are conservative; we'll show expected numbers in the demo.

Pre-call asks so Ben (cc'd) can prepare a quick deep-dive:
1) Can you paste a few example repo names (public or private) you want to hook up?
2) Are you using GitHub Enterprise Cloud with SAML SSO? If so, do you anticipate org-admin installs or a repo-by-repo install?
3) Any security/compliance docs we should read in advance?

I have the following slots available in your windows:
- Wed 2026-07-07 09:30am PST
- Wed 2026-07-07 10:30am PST
- Thu 2026-07-08 02:00pm PST

Or you can pick directly: https://calendly.com/olga-petrov/30min

I've attached a short integration diagram and a 1-page pre-call checklist so we can hit the ground running.

Attachments: [integration-diagram.png (image/png)], [precall-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

Best,
Olga Petrov

Thanks Olga — really helpful. Quick follow-ups:

1) Example repos: codeloom/core-search (private), codeloom/cli-utils (public), codeloom/inference-pipelines (private).
2) Yes — we use GitHub Enterprise Cloud and SAML SSO at the org level. Preferably we avoid granting full org admin; we'd like to scope to repo permissions if possible.
3) I'll upload our internal security policy to the HubSpot portal, but the high-level ask: no long-lived plaintext tokens in our CI, SSO-compatible where possible.

One change — the lead PM just flagged an event and asked to move the call by a day. Can we shift to Fri 2026-07-09 10:00am PST or Mon 2026-07-12 09:30am PST? Either works for us.
